extraction.Name: Ollie Larabee, nee Cottier
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 320 acre allotment at the time it was issued; but that she was advised by the Indian Agency that, if she did not accept it, that it would accumulate taxes, for which it would finally be sold, so she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged it to the McKinley & Allen Co., of Sioux Falls, South Dakota, for $3000.00; was unable to keep payments, and, in 1921, McKinley & Allen foreclosed on her place
extraction.Buyer: McKinley & Allen Co., of Sioux Falls, South Dakota, foreclosed in 1921; mortgage was for $3000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes, that, in 1919, she mortgaged it to the McKinley & Allen Co., of Sioux Falls, South Dakota, for $3000.00; made two payments on this mortgage; was unable to keep payments, and, in 1921, McKinley & Allen foreclosed on her place
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband runs a stock ranch for a living, and that this is his only income
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent; health is not very good, especially troubled with her throat, not able to do her work at times; has five children to support, all of whom have good health; husband has good health and supports her and the children; she was in hopes of paying the mortgage off entirely as she wanted to retain her place but had to let it go; considers she had to take a very poor price for her land; never received any help from the County, State or the United States Government; sworn November 24, 1928; allotment was 320 acres | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
